summary.text: Ray Lara, listed by Ballotpedia as Raymundo Lara, is a Democratic state representative from District 34 who has represented the district since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the House Education Committee, the Rules and Order of Business Committee, and the Transportation, Public Works and Capital Improvements Committee, where he is vice chair.
